text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
I see... So when it comes to the knack for it,
there isn't just one single way, is there?

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: How the prizes are stacked, the strength of the crane... There's much to consider beyond just the center of gravity. In other words—

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
……May I attempt this once more?
I wish to try the exquisite technique I just witnessed.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Once I finally manage to get it,
I would love to give it to you, Trainer.
